name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Sales Leader | Independent Rep & Channel Management, Sales Training & Key Accounts
summary: Sales leader with 15+ years in B2B sales, channel management, and account growth. At Birdeye, I managed a network of 15-20 independent reseller partners, training them to sell and support the product and retaining all but one. I've led sales teams at Wix and Fetch & Funnel, built sales training for tenured account executives, and ranked top three on a team of 8 to 15 at Accelo while quota roughly doubled. I use data to find where a territory or rep is leaving revenue on the table, and I coach to close the gap.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, growing retainer scope by identifying and recommending complementary services.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed a network of 15-20 independent reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, selling through the channel rather than direct, and retained all but one (~94%).
Trained partners to sell and communicate product value, building automated product-training sequences that scaled enablement across the network.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Led the sales team while carrying my own book, closing 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K (several over $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8) while holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Developed sales training for tenured account executives and contributed to hiring, onboarding, and training new hires on a new vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable.
Managed a portfolio that included established retail businesses expanding into e-commerce, building and launching their online storefronts.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps, holding that rank while quota roughly doubled; closed deals of $20K+.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
